model.summary: Model favors NE by 1.8 points (54% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (NE +2.0), Away team on a short week (NE +1.5), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (NE +1.0). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 48.0 total points (CHI 23, NE 25). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 2.3), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 0.7), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
